verdict.rationale: Airbyte's machine-readable OpenAPI spec for its public API is published in the official airbytehq GitHub repo as api.yaml, and the newer Agent API self-serves its own OpenAPI document. However, the ReadMe API reference's OAS download is admin-gated, and every standard docs path for the spec returned 404, so the spec is not downloadable from the documentation site itself. Missing for 10: a self-serve spec download from the official API reference or docs site, a discoverable well-known spec URL, and independent hands-on confirmation that the GitHub spec matches the live API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The ReadMe reference's own OAS download is admin-gated, so the GitHub document is the published machine-readable spec; the newer Agent API separately self-serves its own OpenAPI document at its origin.
